sources.title: Apache Tika Download / release page
sources.locator: Latest Release; Java 17+; package layout; 3.x maintenance line
sources.observed_operation: Opened official release page; checked current version and runtime/package requirements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: 4.x is ZIP with thin launcher plus adjacent lib directory; launcher JAR alone is not runnable. Requires Java 17+. 3.x remains supported separately.
sources.applicability: Pin release/runtime if Tika is selected; local worker is feasible but adds Java deployment. Does not establish app compatibility or performance.

sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1.x Supported Document Formats
sources.released_version_or_commit: Documentation line 4.1.x; release baseline 4.1.0 per S01
sources.observed_operation: Opened versioned official supported-formats page; checked parser/library mappings.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PDFParser uses PDFBox and can hand pages/images to OCR; Office/OOXMLParser uses Apache POI. Format support does not guarantee structure or locator fidelity.
sources.applicability: Supports broad single-adapter candidate for PDFs and slide exports; validate exact PPTX subset and locators.

sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1.x Pages / OCR configuration
sources.released_version_or_commit: Documentation line 4.1.x; behavior marked 4.1.0 in page
sources.locator: Defaults; text=AUTO; render limits; OCR maxPages/AUTO thresholds; crop/media box coordinate rule; experimental inference note
sources.observed_operation: Opened versioned parser configuration page; inspected defaults and exception paths.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AUTO replaces extracted text only if a text recognizer wrote text; otherwise keeps extracted text when no engine, page cap, timeout/error. Default DPI 300; maxImagePixels 100,000,000. Crop/media box depends on renderer. Inference is experimental in 4.1.0.
sources.applicability: Supports bounded OCR and source-state design; app still needs own evidence type, version, and coordinate transform. No OCR accuracy guarantee.

sources.title: Tesseract 5.5.3 command-line manual
sources.released_version_or_commit: Tag 5.5.3; release commit abbreviated db0ec62 per official release page
sources.locator: hOCR, PAGE, TSV output formats; word bounding rectangles and confidence
sources.observed_operation: Opened manpage pinned to 5.5.3 tag; cross-checked official release list identifying 5.5.3 as current stable.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: TSV/PAGE/hOCR are opt-in. TSV records word rectangles/confidence; coordinates are tied to a specific rendered input. Confidence is not verified truth.
sources.applicability: Use for optional local OCR and region jumps only when geometry is retained and mapped to the same source version.

sources.title: Apache PDFBox 3.0 FAQ
sources.released_version_or_commit: PDFBox documentation line 3.0; no patch version pinned by FAQ
sources.locator: Text extraction order; no-text/scanned-image; custom encoding; extraction permission/password
sources.observed_operation: Opened official FAQ and inspected extraction-order and unreadable/encrypted cases.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default follows PDF content-stream order, not guaranteed reading order; setSortByPosition(true) is an alternative. Scanned image PDFs have no selectable text; custom/unmapped encodings may yield gibberish; permission bit may require owner password.
sources.applicability: Test reading order and expose scanned, encoding, and password states; do not assume complete or faithful text.

sources.title: SQLite FTS5 official documentation
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live SQLite reference; no single release pinned; contentless-delete introduced in 3.43.0, not recommended here
sources.observed_operation: Opened official reference; inspected tokenizer defaults, BM25, sync contract, update/delete, integrity-check.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: unicode61 default is based on Unicode 6.1 and removes Latin diacritics. Porter is English-specific. Trigram supports substring; <3 Unicode character full-text queries have no matches. External-content tables are caller-synchronized; triggers do not backfill; rebuild and integrity-check are available.
sources.applicability: Local lexical baseline if shipped SQLite includes FTS5. Keep generation replacement in one same-database transaction and test invariants; no all-language relevance guarantee.

sources.title: Tantivy 0.26.2 tokenizer and index writer docs
sources.locator: Default/custom tokenizers; IndexWriter add/commit/rollback; search workflow
sources.observed_operation: Opened versioned Rust crate docs for tokenizer and commit/search workflow.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default tokenization splits punctuation/whitespace and lowercases; en_stem adds English stemming; custom filters are possible. Changes become searchable on commit; separate metadata requires consistency handling.
sources.applicability: Rust-native lexical alternative if separate index and cross-store atomicity are acceptable; language evaluation remains required.

sources.title: sqlite-vec README and v0.1.9 release
sources.released_version_or_commit: v0.1.9 commit e9f598a; current README labels project pre-v1
sources.locator: README pre-v1 warning and vec0/KNN; v0.1.9 DELETE release note
sources.observed_operation: Opened project README and release history; checked current stable/alpha tags and DELETE fix.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Repository warns pre-v1/breaking changes. v0.1.9 fixes DELETE SQLITE_DONE with vec0 metadata text longer than 12 characters; v0.1.10 alpha also exists.

sources.title: sqlite-vec issue #274
sources.released_version_or_commit: Fixed by sqlite-vec v0.1.9 commit e9f598a (S08)
sources.locator: Issue report and linked v0.1.9 release
sources.observed_operation: Opened issue URL and compared its subject/fix reference with maintainer release record.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reported DELETE on vec0 with long metadata text columns causing SQLITE_DONE in affected versions; v0.1.9 release says it fixes this case.
sources.applicability: Useful replacement/delete regression evidence for optional semantic index; not a claim that current release remains broken.

sources.title: ASF Jira TIKA-4883
sources.released_version_or_commit: Resolved/fixed for Apache Tika 4.1.0; PR #3145 merged 2026-09-09
sources.locator: Issue description/resolution: PDF AUTO OCR on sparse/unmapped text could append OCR after bad extracted text
sources.observed_operation: Opened ASF issue page; checked description, fix version, and linked PR.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AUTO OCR triggers under low text/unmapped glyph conditions; old behavior could emit original page text and append OCR output.
sources.applicability: Parser output can duplicate or preserve bad extraction; keep source labels and test success/fallback semantics.

sources.title: Tika PR #3145 fix/release-note/test diff
sources.released_version_or_commit: Merged commit bdc72de; commits d5cc621 and bf4932a; included in Tika 4.1.0
sources.locator: Release note behavior; TextRecognizer capability; changed file list includes PDFParserTest and ContentEnrichersTest; merge/check state
sources.observed_operation: Opened merged PR/diff; inspected release-note additions and test-file/test-case additions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AUTO replaces only when configured TextRecognizer actually writes output; otherwise preserves extracted content when engine absent, page cap exhausted, timeout/error. Annotation-only enrichers do not replace text.
sources.applicability: Issue-to-fix-to-regression trail for replacement state. Upstream tests are not this application's executed validation.

sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1 Java API / isolation guide
sources.locator: Consider a service first; PipesForkParser; warning about parsing untrusted files in-process
sources.observed_operation: Opened the versioned 4.1.x Java API guide and inspected direct-parse isolation and configured Pipes guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Direct embedded parser opts out of process isolation; PipesForkParser/service routes provide crash/timeout containment where configured.
sources.applicability: Supports local subprocess boundary and resource caps; does not imply remote enrichers are safe to enable.

sources.title: Apache Tika 4.1.x Security model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Documentation line 4.1.x; versioned page identifies Tika 4.1.x
sources.locator: In-process parsing and denial of service; Pipes process bounds; Tika server/gRPC trust model
sources.observed_operation: Opened official versioned security page and inspected parser isolation, output limits, timeout/heap bounds, and server trust assumptions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Direct parsers run in caller thread/heap; output limits bound output, not work. Pipes/PipesForkParser parse in forked JVMs; configure heap ceiling and timeout. Tika server/gRPC are not caller-authentication boundaries.
sources.applicability: If Tika is selected, isolate parsing from UI process and configure time/resource bounds. Keep it local and do not expose a server to untrusted callers; remote OCR/VLM is still a separate data-flow decision.
